Name: No Friendship Decay - Reborn
Author: TheFluffyRobot
AuthorLabel: CJBok and Pathoschild and The Fluffy Robot
Description:
[center][i]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/pHxUUOh.png[/img][/i][i]﻿[/i][/center][i]
[/i][size=5]
[/size][size=6]Purpose[/size][size=5]
[/size][size=4]The purpose of this mod is to prevent friendship decay without any extra mods.

The original No Friendship Decay mod is no longer maintained and the other alternative is to use CJB Cheat Menu. This mod is a refactored version of what [url=https://github.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods/blob/master/CJBCheatsMenu/Framework/Cheats/Relationships/NoFriendshipDecayCheat.cs]is implemented in CJB Cheat Menu[/url]. [b]All credit should go to CJBok and Pathoschild for making this in the first place.[/b][/size][size=4][b]Thank you both![/b][/size][size=5]
[/size]
[size=6]Instructions[/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=4][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿﻿ (requies 4.0.0 or above)[/size]
[*][size=4]Download this mod and unzip the NoFriendshipDecayReborn folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew [/font][/size][size=4][font=Courier New]Valley/Mods[/font]. The latter can be found in your game's installation directory [i](alternatively, this can be installed using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]the Stardrop mod manager[/url]﻿)
[/i][/size]
[*][size=4]Run the game as you would, per the SMAPI instructions[/size]
[/list][size=6]Compatibility
[list]
[*] [size=3]Requires SMAPI 4.0.0+[/size]
[*][size=3][size=6][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows [i](untested on other platforms)[/i][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3] Works with other mods[/size]
[*][size=3] Works in multiplayer and in splitscreen[/size]
[*][size=3]If you discover a bug, leave a comment on this page or create a [url=https://github.com/jamespfluger/Stardew-NoFriendshipDecayReborn/issues/new]new issue on GitHub[/url]﻿﻿﻿﻿ to track it[/size]
[/list][size=3]GitHub repo link: [url=https://github.com/jamespfluger/Stardew-NoFriendshipDecayReborn/][size=3]https://github.com/jamespfluger/Stardew-NoFriendshipDecayReborn/[/size][/url]
[/size][/size][size=6][size=3] [/size]Credits
[size=4][b][u]Again, all credit is to CJBok and Pathoschild for writing [url=https://github.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods/blob/master/CJBCheatsMenu/Framework/Cheats/Relationships/NoFriendshipDecayCheat.cs]the original code[/url] and keeping it updated.[/u][/b][/size][/size][size=6]
[/size]
